nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity. If $f$ is a computable function from binary strings to natural numbers with $f(x) \le K(x)$ for every binary string $x$, then there is a natural number $B$ with $f(x) \le B$ for every binary string $x$.
nodes.title: A computable lower bound of Kolmogorov complexity is bounded

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity, and let $S$ be a recursively enumerable (recognizable) set of pairs $(x, n)$ of a binary string $x$ and a natural number $n$ such that $n \le K(x)$ for every $(x, n) \in S$. Then there is a natural number $B$ with $n \le B$ for every $(x, n) \in S$.
nodes.title: Chaitin's incompleteness theorem

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity and let $f$ be a partial recursive function from binary strings to binary strings. Then there is a natural number $c$ such that $K(y) \le K(x) + c$ for all binary strings $x$ and $y$ such that $f(x)$ is defined and equal to $y$.
nodes.title: A partial recursive map raises complexity by at most a constant

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be the universal description method, $K$ Kolmogorov complexity, and $|p|$ the length of a binary string $p$. There is a natural number $b$ such that for all binary strings $x$ and $p$, if $p$ is a shortest description of $x$, that is, $U(p)$ is defined and equal to $x$ and $|p| = K(x)$, then $|p| \le K(p) + b$.
nodes.title: Shortest descriptions are incompressible

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity and $|x|$ the length of a binary string $x$. The set of incompressible binary strings, that is, of binary strings $x$ with $|x| \le K(x)$, is not decidable.
nodes.title: The incompressible strings are not decidable

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity and $|x|$ the length of a binary string $x$. The set of incompressible binary strings, that is, of binary strings $x$ with $|x| \le K(x)$, is not recursively enumerable (recognizable).
nodes.title: The incompressible strings are not recognizable

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity. The set of pairs $(x, n)$ of a binary string $x$ and a natural number $n$ with $n \le K(x)$ is not recursively enumerable (recognizable).
nodes.title: Kolmogorov complexity is not lower semicomputable

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity and $|x|$ the length of a binary string $x$. There is no recursively enumerable (recognizable) set $S$ of binary strings such that for every natural number $n$ some $x \in S$ has $|x| \ge n$, and every $x \in S$ satisfies $|x| \le K(x)$.
nodes.title: No recognizable set with arbitrarily long members consists of incompressible strings

nodes.summary: Let $K$ denote Kolmogorov complexity. The set of pairs $(x, n)$ of a binary string $x$ and a natural number $n$ with $K(x) \le n$ is recursively enumerable (recognizable).
nodes.title: Kolmogorov complexity is upper semicomputable

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be the universal description method. The set of pairs $(x, p)$ of binary strings such that $U(p)$ is defined and equal to $x$ is recursively enumerable (recognizable).
nodes.title: The description relation is recognizable

conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
